fields.statement: Verifier at 5d9d85ae (attempt 5): go test -trimpath ./internal/tui/inboxapp passes all 27 tests with a fake runner: rows per item in order (TestRowPerItemInOrder); Enter opens the action for question, blocker, gate (open), signoff, failed and accept items (TestEnterOpensActionPerKind, TestGateAnswersEachThenResumes, TestAccept*, TestSignoff*, TestResolve*); other kinds show detail and ask for the run's tab (TestOtherKindShowsDetailAndOpensTab); empty inbox shows one line (TestEmptyInbox); the new TestGateResumeFailureShowsNote shows 'answered; resume failed: ...' after a failed run.resume. TestScripts tui-inbox-app (cmp of tui app inbox --once with inbox --json, empty and with items), plan-workflow-open (question answer --run from the main checkout writes answer-park-disk into the planned change set in the run's worktree, refuses a question the gate did not stop on, then resume ships), question-answer, arbiter-question, inbox-open, inbox-list and describe-golden all pass; go vet and gofmt are clean. In the diff, the app now answers gates with question.answer <q> <words> --run <run>, routed through the generic argv call in cmd/rhiza/tui.go. internal/api tests pass except TestReadBudget, a timing budget that fails here under load average 9 on 4 CPUs and fails worse on the parent commit, so this change did not cause it.
